GoalOptions.Label: Ensure AI Governance
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to establish a robust governance framework for the ML Inference layer, ensuring its ethical, compliant, and performant operation within e-discovery. Success means clear accountability for model lifecycle, data provenance, and output validation, satisfying both technical and legal stakeholders.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize System Performance
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to define architectural and operational standards that guarantee the ML Inference solution consistently meets sub-200ms p99 latency requirements. Success will be measured by the system's ability to scale efficiently under sustained load while maintaining high accuracy in RAG, citation verification, and TAR processes.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Legal Risk
GoalOptions.Text: A key objective is to articulate how the AI-driven data minimization and privilege review platform systematically reduces legal and reputational risks for clients. Success involves demonstrating auditable controls over AI bias, data security, and the defensibility of automated review decisions, crucial for compliance and audit teams.

GoalOptions.Label: Drive Platform Adoption
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to clearly communicate the technical and operational advantages of the ML Inference platform to foster internal and external adoption. Success means stakeholders, including legal professionals and IT teams, understand the value proposition, reliability, and security of the solution, leading to broader integration and usage.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Performance Criteria
Criteria: ML inference latency consistently meets p99 < 200ms under peak load.
Model accuracy and F1-scores for TAR/predictive coding tasks exceed 90%.
System demonstrates high availability (99.99%) and fault tolerance across microservices.
Data lineage and model versioning are fully auditable and traceable.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Compliance & Audit Criteria
Criteria: All AI decisions impacting privilege review are explainable and justifiable to legal counsel.
Data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) are demonstrably adhered to in data handling and processing.
Audit trails for all data access, model training, and inference requests are complete and immutable.
Bias detection and mitigation strategies for AI models are documented and regularly reviewed.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Strategic Criteria
Criteria: The governance framework clearly defines roles and responsibilities for AI model lifecycle management.
Scalability mechanisms for the cloud-native, multi-tenant architecture are well-defined and tested.
Integration points with existing legal tech ecosystems are clearly documented and supported.
The solution demonstrably contributes to significant cost savings or efficiency gains in e-discovery workflows.
